title: Just Juice Bar Range Iced Caramel Macchiato 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: The Just Juice Bar Range Iced Caramel Macchiato Nic Salt e-liquid delivers the ultimate indulgence for coffee lovers. This exquisite blend combines the bold, roasted richness of freshly brewed coffee with the velvety sweetness of Caramel, perfectly complemented by a cool, icy exhale. Ideal for vapers who enjoy dessert-inspired flavours with a refreshing twist, this e-liquid provides a truly satisfying experience. With a 60PG/40VG ratio, this Nicotine Salt e-liquid is crafted for optimal performance in Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices and pod systems. The smooth Nic Salt formulation ensures rapid nicotine delivery and a comfortable throat hit, offering a satisfying and effective alternative to traditional tobacco products. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Iced Caramel Macchiato makes for a luxurious all-day vape. Part of the Just Juice Bar Range, this collection brings the bold, concentrated flavours associated with disposable vapes into a more versatile and economical format for use with reusable vape devices. Other standout flavours in the range include Lychee & Mango, Spearmint, and Sour Blue Razz Lime. Please Note : All flavours in the Just Juice Bar Range feature a subtle hint of ice to enhance the flavour profile.
